node.title: Endpoint saturation rigidity for the strict A=3 Hankel profile
node.statement: At the first unresolved strict A=3 parameter degree, write rho=4m-1, N=16m, e=m, and delta=m-1. If the desired T<=rho+1 cap fails, exceptional-root charging and parameter-root incidence force the unique count T=4m+1. If O is the total number of domain roots omitted from the specialized generic generators, then O<=delta and the exact column-capacity deficit is 1+O<=m. Hence at least 15m=15N/16 domain points occur as roots at exactly m supported slopes, exhausting the parameter degree of Q_Z(x). This is a necessary extremal profile, not an exclusion of it.
